text: The foldable's software goes beyond simple "open" and "closed" states
full-pick-text: The foldable's software goes beyond simple "open" and "closed" states. There will be support for "tabletop" mode with specific UIs for it. Users can "peek through" at one side of the inner display by slightly opening the device. StandBy will support a "tent" mode when the iPhone is charging.
notes:
